The file voice_ai/app.py is described as: Web Frontend for the Offline Voice Assistant
----------------------------------------------
Runs the Vosk + pyttsx3 voice assistant in a background thread,
and exposes a simple web UI (Flask) with:

- Live conversation log (chat history)
- Speech-to-text via microphone
- Text-to-speech replies
- Typed message input (works even without a mic / model)
- Voice ON/OFF toggle (mutes spoken replies, text still appears)
- Clear chat button

This does NOT replace assistant.py's core logic - it imports
the same helper functions and adds a web front end on top.

Run with:
    python3 app.py

Then open http://localhost:5000 in your browser.

ONLY if the voice toggle is currently on. Safe to call even if

has ever been started) - it lazily creates one.

'10 second timer', 'remind me in 2 hours'. Returns seconds (int)
